description:
Track and evaluate the performance of your investment portfolio across stocks, cryptocurrencies, and other assets.


* New: The dashboard has a new "Volatility (annualized)" widget. It always scales to one year, so you can compare the value across reporting periods and with published figures.
* New: CSV importer for XTB (cash operations), including CFD results and spin-off payments.
* New: PDF importer for Alpac Capital.
* Improvement: Improved PDF importers for Arkéa Direct Bank, Bank11, Bison, Commerzbank, Debitum, DEGIRO, FKB, Findependent, Ford Money, GenoBroker, Hypothekarbank Lenzburg, Liberty Vorsorge, MeDirect, N26, NIBC, OLB, Orange Bank, Quirin Privatbank and Scalable Capital.
* Improvement: The Edit Security dialog opens much faster with large taxonomies. Classifications are now picked from a searchable list, and ones already assigned are grayed out.
* Improvement: Faster performance calculation, and faster taxonomy and price change columns in security lists.
* Improvement: Views are recalculated less often while prices are updated, so the application stays responsive.
* Improvement: Renaming or copying a taxonomy now also renames its top-level node, and copying keeps the notes of all categories.
* Fix: The Sharpe ratio widget now uses annualized volatility. Before, the value depended on the length of the reporting period.
* Fix: CSV import of dividends, taxes and fees now works when only the exchange rate column is mapped, and no longer aborts for securities without a currency.
* Fix: An error ("ConcurrentModificationException") no longer occurs when investment plans run at startup. Transactions created before a missing price stops a plan are now reported and saved.
* Fix: On Linux, table headers and toolbar labels stay readable when the window is not focused.
* Fix: On Linux, the error "Unknown column layout data" no longer appears in the payments matrix.
* Fix: Changing the currency no longer causes an error while "Show amount to invest" is turned on in rebalancing.
* Fix: The donut chart now starts at the same angle as the pie chart.
* Fix: The Trade Republic and XTB CSV imports now show the correct wizard title.
* Fix: Closing the "Find quote provider" dialog no longer causes an error.
